description:
Starts AI clipping of a long video into vertical 9:16 short clips with burned-in captions and a hook title, plus optional cold-open hooks, music and B-roll. Spends credits: 1 per started minute of the processed range (minimum 1), charged when the job is created. One job processes at most 30 minutes of video; split longer videos with start_sec and end_sec. Jobs cannot be cancelled.

Before calling, run quote_clip_job, show the price to the user and get explicit agreement. max_credits is required; the call is refused without charging if the price is higher. Some clients also ask the user to confirm. If the same request was already submitted with this API key in the last 10 minutes, that job is returned instead of charging again.

Use for turning a podcast, stream, interview, lecture or vlog into Shorts, Reels or TikTok clips. Not for: transcripts only (create_transcription), changing the look of an existing job (recut_clip_job), or re-running a failed job for free (retry_clip_job).

Key parameters: source_url (public link; local files are not supported), start_sec and end_sec to process only part of the video, video_mode (podcast for talking heads), clip_length, caption_style, language (omit to auto-detect) and prompt to steer which moments are picked. Call get_options_guide to explain option values.

Returns job_id right away with status queued and the credits charged. Processing takes a few minutes for short videos and up to tens of minutes for a full 30-minute range; clips appear one by one. Next, call get_clip_job with wait_sec=50 until the status is completed or failed. If processing fails, credits are not returned automatically: retry_clip_job re-runs the job for free, or the user can contact support@mnogo-reels.ru with the job_id. On the free plan clip files are kept for 30 days.

add_music.description: Add quiet background music from the MnogoReels library.

agentic_mode.description: Extra AI review pass that refines where clips start and end. Slower.

allow_duplicate.description: Set true only if the user explicitly wants a second identical job within 10 minutes (it is charged again).

b_roll_ai_images.description: Insert AI-generated illustrative images as B-roll.

b_roll_motion_graphics.description: Insert AI motion-graphics B-roll (animated titles, charts, diagrams).

caption_style.description: Burned-in caption style; empty means no captions. Call get_options_guide to see what each style looks like.

clip_length.description: Target length of each clip. auto lets the AI decide; 30_60s suits Shorts, Reels and TikTok.

cold_open.description: Start each clip with its strongest moment as a teaser, and also produce standalone hook clips and a looped teaser.

emojis.description: Add emojis to captions where they fit.

end_sec.description: End of the part to process, in seconds. Default: the end of the video (its length is looked up automatically when the platform reports it). At most 30 minutes after start_sec.

framing.description: auto = smart crop; full_frame = keep the whole wide frame on a blurred background; portrait_only = always crop to the subject.

hook_style.description: Style of the hook title shown at the start of each clip; none hides it.

keep_whole_video.description: Do not cut into clips: render the whole video once with captions, music and B-roll. Use only for videos that are already vertical and short.

language.description: Two-letter language code of the speech, e.g. en or ru. Omit to auto-detect. Never pass 'auto'.

max_credits.description: Spending limit for this call in credits. Required. Use the credits value from quote_clip_job after the user agreed; the call is refused without charging if the price (or its upper bound) is higher.

outro.description: Ending added to every clip: default branded outro, soon/like short Russian text cards, custom = your saved outro image.

prompt.description: What kind of moments to pick, in plain words, e.g. 'funny moments about money'.

smart_cut.description: Remove pauses and filler words inside clips. Works only with video_mode podcast (general-beta always does it); ignored for other modes.

source_url.description: Public link to the video: YouTube, VK Video, RuTube, Dzen, Twitch, Yandex Disk file, Google Drive file, or a direct .mp4/.mov/.mkv/.webm link. Local files are not supported.

start_sec.description: Start of the part to process, in seconds from the beginning. Default 0.

story_arc_style.description: Build each clip as a story (cold open, main part, payoff). Any value except none also turns on cold_open.

video_mode.description: How the video was filmed: general, podcast (talking heads), general-beta (SmartCut: removes pauses and filler words), stream (screen + webcam), vlog, fitness.

name: create_clip_job

credits.description: Credits charged for this job (same formula as the API).

deduplicated.description: True when an identical request from the last 10 minutes was returned instead of creating a new job (nothing was charged now).

next_step.description: e.g. "Call get_clip_job with job_id and wait_sec=50."

title: Create clip job (spends credits)
